output_list.reason: changeDecimals can be exploited by the dev, it increases the token value. The decimals value is used as a parameter to calculate transfer amount in RemiCoin.changeDecimals(2) will increase the transfer amount to be 10^4 times. This will effectively devalue the token.
changeDecimals can be called by the deployer, it allows arbitrary token value increase.

The function takes an integer _decimals as input. Then assigns it to the decimals state variable. If _decimals is greater than 255, this will lead to an overflow and cause the decimals to be set to a wrong value.
